description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the order under Revenue Protection Act, that indicator for preferential rate of duty for imports under Singapore-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement, w.e.f. 20.07.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a Revenue Protection Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, which establishes new customs duty rates and regulations for specific imported articles. It constitutes a regulatory framework for import duties and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or miscellaneous categories.
